generation.scope: Every finite Frobenius point of the fifteen-dimensional component closure with twenty reduced pairwise Ext-orthogonal point modules admits a vertex-dimension-two simple, without assuming regularity at the point. Failure to admit one forces a nonreduced mark or a separator singularity edge. Stable four-layer cuts extend precisely when their top self-Ext is nonzero.

open_mathematics: Use two-dimensional simple markings to reduce the covered asymmetric strata to cyclic binary tensor normal forms, and test regularity in those forms.
